chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
This world has been created for other than itself, and has not been created for itself.

key_terms.الدُّنْيَا: The world, the lower realm of existence

ai.seo_question: What is the purpose of the world according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this profound statement from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) articulates the Shia theological concept of *al-dunya khuliqat li-ghayriha*, emphasizing that the material realm is a transient vehicle for attaining eternal proximity to God. This perspective aligns with the concept of *Tawhid* in action, where worldly existence is validated only through its utility in spiritual ascent and moral refinement. It serves as a reminder that attachment to the world for its own sake leads to spiritual stagnation, while utilizing it for divine purposes fulfills the purpose of creation.
